script_text: Uranus, your ruler as an Air sign, is forcing a radical awakening this week — no turning back. Monday through Wednesday, Pluto's conjunction to your natal Sun in your 1st House amplifies authority, while Saturn's square to Neptune in your 3rd House sparks frustrating breakdowns in work communication and contracts. Tuesday is your roughest day. Wednesday marks a shift as Venus enters your 5th House, trining Jupiter in Gemini to spark romance and creativity. Thursday onward, the Moon moves through your 7th House spotlighting significant connections. Harmonious Mercury trines smooth weekend negotiations and deepen conversations. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Jupiter in your 5th House, sparking romance and creative confidence. Friday is your warning day as Saturn squares Neptune in your 3rd House, threatening communication. Reclaim one boundary you've been avoiding to harness Pluto's 1st House power. Follow for daily cosmic updates and deeper insight.
